project_info.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Modified for 'Clean & Fresh' utility
project_info.vibe: Clean, fresh, minimal, trustworthy, premium yet accessible.

rules: No default Tailwind blues or teals. Use ONLY the specified palette.
Tint greys with a subtle green/blue hue.
Primary button text must be white for contrast.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-[#1A2E2A]
hierarchy.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#5C7671]

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Maintain strict contrast ratio for text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-16) to create breathing room and elevate the 'premium' feel.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: MODE A (Tetris Grid) for marketing sections (Home, About). Wide gaps (gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.product_grid: Standard clean grid (gap-6) for Shop page. Optical alignment heavily enforced.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-8 or p-12 for content blocks with borders.

components.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) sticky top with 1px border-b border-[#E2E8F0].
components.buttons: Flat solid background. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md. Slight rounded-md radius.
components.cards: Solid surface (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0), soft shadow-sm. Nested elements must respect parent radius.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Input fields: clean borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#84A98C] focus:border-transparent.
components.badges: For 'Made in India' and 'Factory Direct Pricing': Soft background pills (e.g., bg-[#E8F1F2] text-[#2C6E49]) with tiny icons.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have visible hover states. transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for product grids using framer-motion.

images.description: Clean water splash for 'fresh' vibe. Use with heavy light overlay (bg-white/60) so text is readable.
Clear plastic bottle for liquid detergent/cleaner.
Hand reaching for minimalistic cleaning products (lifestyle).
Indian flag badge graphic for 'Made in India' section.

rules: Hero image must have gradient overlay for text contrast.
Product images in grids should have consistent aspect ratios (e.g., aspect-square or aspect-[4/5]).

instructions_to_main_agent: ALWAYS include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button') for interactive elements.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out-of-the-box for the marketing pages (Home/About) - use raw HTML/Tailwind.
Use Shadcn for interactive features (Filters, Cart, Dialog, Checkout).
Ensure 'Made in India' and 'Factory Direct Pricing' badges are prominently placed near price or CTA on Product Details.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Rely on Outfit (via Google Fonts).
Keep standard layouts for Checkout (familiarity = conversion), but inject brand colors.
For the e-commerce structure, ensure a robust sidebar filter on the Shop page.
Always wrap interactive Grid items correctly with subgrid or direct children rules.
CRITICAL: We are using standard .js and .jsx files. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Setup guidelines and imports should reflect ES6 Javascript.
